about: [O6b] The parts as things (brief O6b §3): the ten beat with a sedan's door and its bonnet lying in the lane under the el (&ten=parts), on foot straight into the nearest one, W held 3 s (it stops me: never inside its box), then E into my coupe and north up the lane over the door at about 30 km/h (tools/lib/o6b_damage.mjs parts): the car meets it (a bump that slows it), the door is shoved on and comes to rest again. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6b_parts.json
